entries.headline: Nintendo designates November 1 as Pikmin Day; Pikmin 4 Switch 2 Edition launches November 12
entries.summary: Nintendo has designated November 1 as Pikmin Day. The Pikmin Day Direct also confirmed Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy for November 12 and highlighted updates for Pikmin Bloom and the Hello! Pikmin shorts.
entries.verification: Nintendo News directly confirms the observance, release date, and related announcements.
entries.timeNote: The source confirms dates but does not provide a precise launch time.

entries.headline: World of Warcraft: Forever will launch with official controller support
entries.summary: Xbox Wire says World of Warcraft: Forever launches November 4 with official Gamepad (Alpha) support.
entries.verification: Xbox Wire directly states the launch date and controller-support status.
entries.timeNote: No precise launch time is provided in this packet item.

entries.headline: Phantom Blade Zero sells more than 4 million copies in 72 hours
entries.summary: 4Gamer relays an S-GAME announcement that Phantom Blade Zero surpassed four million sales within 72 hours of release. Dynamic aggregate scores and review counts are not treated as durable facts here.
entries.verification: 4Gamer clearly attributes the milestone to S-GAME.
entries.timeNote: The milestone is expressed as a 72-hour window; no exact announcement time is supplied.

entries.headline: Zoku Portopia Serial Murder Case: Forgotten Burial reveals its first voice cast
entries.summary: G-MODE revealed the first cast for the game, with Tomoaki Maeno voicing Yasuhiko Mano (Yasu). It is planned for Switch, Switch 2, and Steam on March 4, 2027.
entries.verification: 4Gamer and Denfaminicogamer independently relay the same G-MODE announcement.
entries.timeNote: The release date is confirmed, but no exact release time is given.

entries.headline: VRChat says it does not plan AI-content labels or exclusion filters
entries.summary: Following a user survey, VRChat said it does not plan to add an AI-generated label or a search filter that excludes AI content, citing risks of deception and harassment. AUTOMATON separately reports user backlash on Steam.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON quotes VRChat's public policy statement and separates it from observed community reaction.
entries.timeNote: VRChat stated the policy on October 29; the report entered this edition's coverage window.

entries.headline: Rain98 delayed to 2027; demo update planned for early 2027
entries.summary: C#4R4CT3R delayed Rain98 from its 2026 window to 2027 and plans a major demo update with additional story content in early 2027.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON relays the developer's public statement with the old and new windows.

entries.headline: Castaway Diary: Portal to the Unknown Isles Early Access delayed to 2027
entries.summary: REMIMORY delayed the Steam Early Access release from 2026 to 2027 and published a four-step roadmap leading to launch.
entries.verification: Gematsu relays REMIMORY's press release and identifies the platform and revised window.
entries.timeNote: Only a release year is confirmed.

entries.headline: Radi Art announces dark visual novel PRIMA MATERIA for PC
entries.summary: Top Hat Studios and Synergia developer Radi Art announced PRIMA MATERIA, a dark surreal visual novel due for PC via Steam in 2027.
entries.verification: Gematsu relays the publisher and developer announcement with platform and year.
entries.timeNote: Only a release year is confirmed.

entries.headline: PowerWash Simulator 2 Barbie Pack launches December 3
entries.summary: FuturLab announced a five-level Barbie-themed pack for December 3, with split-screen and Free Play multiplayer support.
entries.verification: Gematsu relays FuturLab's announcement and the pack's date and contents.
entries.timeNote: No precise launch time is provided.

entries.headline: The Farmer Was Replaced launches The Miner Was Replaced DLC
entries.summary: Metaroot released the large The Miner Was Replaced DLC on November 3, alongside a mobile version. The Steam price reported for Japan is ¥1,100.
entries.verification: 4Gamer identifies the developer, date, DLC, Steam price, and simultaneous mobile release.
entries.timeNote: The date is confirmed without a precise release time.

entries.headline: Report: Bend Studio's next game may be revealed and released in 2027
entries.summary: VGC relays an MP1st report claiming Bend Studio's unannounced project could be revealed and released in 2027 and is a third-person cooperative game rather than a live-service title or Days Gone 2. Sony and the studio have not confirmed the claims.
entries.verification: The current evidence is a secondary relay of anonymous sourcing, with no first-party confirmation.

entries.headline: Nintendo plans a London midnight launch for Zelda: Ocarina of Time on Switch 2
entries.summary: Nintendo will hold a midnight launch at Argos Tottenham Court Road in London ahead of the November 5 release. Purchasers can receive an N64-style UK box replica and ocarina key ring while supplies last.
entries.verification: VGC reports an official Nintendo UK event with a specific venue, date, and gift conditions.
entries.timeNote: The event is a regional midnight launch; the packet does not provide an exact timestamp.

entries.headline: Sci-fi puzzle game Message From Aliens launches
entries.summary: Artless Games released Message From Aliens on November 2. Set in 2058, the game asks players to analyze and decode an alien language.
entries.verification: 4Gamer identifies the developer, release date, game, and core premise.
entries.timeNote: The release date is confirmed without a precise time.
